episodes.title: Dio the Destroyer
episodes.summary: England, 1868. A thief tries to raid an overturned carriage, but discovers that two of the occupants, a man and his young son are still alive. The man, George Joestar, proclaims he will forever be indebted to his savior, who reveals himself to be Dario Brando.

episodes.title: A Letter from the Past
episodes.summary: Seven years later in 1888, JoJo and Dio are supposedly getting along, though JoJo is still fearful of Dio. Meanwhile, Dio plots to liberate the Joestar family of their fortune.

episodes.title: Youth with Dio
episodes.summary: JoJo prepares to turn Dio in to the police.

episodes.title: Overdrive
episodes.summary: Three days later, JoJo awakens to find Erina nursing him back to health in the hospital. As they rekindle their friendship, they encounter a strange man named Will A. Zeppeli.

episodes.title: The Dark Knights
episodes.summary: A talented young pickpocket named Poco unwittingly lures JoJo and company into an encounter with Dio, Tarukus, and Blueford.

episodes.title: Tomorrow's Courage
episodes.summary: The encounter between JoJo and the Knights continues.

episodes.title: Sorrowful Successor
episodes.summary: The encounter against Tarukus comes to an end. Poco's family is in grave danger. JoJo meets Dire, Straizo, and Tonpetty.

episodes.title: Bloody Battle! JoJo & Dio
episodes.summary: The party are received by Doobie. Dire faces off against Dio. Straizo takes on Pajyu, Jones, Pluton, and Barnum.

episodes.title: The Final Ripple!
episodes.summary: As Dio falls following his battle with JoJo, he decapitates himself before the ripple reaches his head, which is recovered by his zombie servant Wang Chung.

episodes.title: New York's JoJo
episodes.summary: In 1938, 49 years after Jonathan Joestar's death, Speedwagon and Straizo travel to Mexico, where they discover an underground room filled with similar looking masks and a petrified body believed to be the being who created them.

episodes.title: The Game Master
episodes.summary: As expected, Straizo recovers from Joseph's attack and uses the laser eye attack Dio used to seemingly pierce through JoJo's head and neck. However, this turns out to be a clever trick by Joseph.

episodes.title: The Pillar Man
episodes.summary: Joseph is confronted by one of Stroheim's men, Donovan, but manages to subdue him, learning that Speedwagon is still alive.

episodes.title: JoJo vs. The Ultimate Lifeform
episodes.summary: As Joseph begins to fight against Santana, Joseph finds his Ripple to not be effective against Santana, but it still helps protect him from the Pillar Man's attacks. Joseph appears to be unconscious after receiving a powerful hit.

episodes.title: Ultimate Warriors from Ancient Times
episodes.summary: Speedwagon brings statued remains of Santana to the headquarters of his foundation in Washington, D.C., where it is shown Santana is still alive, but his scientists are able to keep him dormant through the use of ultraviolet light.

episodes.title: To Be a Hero
episodes.summary: Caesar engages Wamuu in battle for killing Mark, using his Bubble Launcher technique to surround the Pillar Man in Ripple enfused bubbles.

episodes.title: Ripple Teacher Lisa Lisa
episodes.summary: Wanting to teach JoJo to control his Ripple powers, Caesar takes him to Venice to meet his teacher, Lisa Lisa.

episodes.title: Laying Some Elaborate Traps!
episodes.summary: Lisa Lisa explains to JoJo and Caesar how the creator of the Stone Mask, Kars, is seeking a perfectly cut Red Stone of Aja known as the Super Aja to power the Stone Mask and become the ultimate life form.

episodes.title: Von Stroheim's Revenge
episodes.summary: As JoJo awaits to warn Lisa Lisa about the Pillar Men, Esidisi's brain takes over the body of Suzi Q and sends the Super Aja off on a boat bound for Venice before confronting Lisa Lisa.

episodes.title: Rushing Towards the Cliffs of Death
episodes.summary: Stroheim starts using his new mechanical body, which was designed to surpass Santana, to fight against Kars. However, it proves futile against Kars' Light Mode.

episodes.title: Caesar's Lonely Youth
episodes.summary: Lisa Lisa tells JoJo of Caesar's childhood, in which he took to crime at a young age after being abandoned by his debt-ridden father, Mario.

episodes.title: The Hundred vs. Two Strategy
episodes.summary: Whilst following Wamuu's trail of blood, JoJo and Lisa Lisa encounter another vampire named Wired Beck.

episodes.title: A True Warrior
episodes.summary: Before JoJo's and Wamuu's race begins, it is revealed that during each lap, there will be a different weapon for whoever can grab it from a pillar first.

episodes.title: The Warrior Returning to the Wind
episodes.summary: Launching his Final Mode attack, Gathering Gale, which starts peeling away his own body, Wamuu begins firing a stream of wind capable of cutting stone towards JoJo.

episodes.title: The Link to JoJo
episodes.summary: Being forced to cling onto a rope to stop Lisa Lisa from falling to her death, JoJo is at a huge disadvantage against Kars.

episodes.title: Birth of the Ultimate Being!
episodes.summary: Kars demonstrates his new powers, turning his hand into a flesh-eating squirrel that deals damage to Stroheim. The sun rises, leaving a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: The Man Who Became a God
episodes.summary: JoJo's victory, along with his arm, is cut short when Kars manages to survive the volcano by forming a shield of air bubbles to protect him from its deadly lava.

episodes.title: A Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
episodes.summary: In 1987, in Japan, a boy named Jotaro Kujo has willingly turned himself into jail, refusing to leave. Jotaro's mother, Holly, requests help from her father, Joseph Joestar, who travels to Japan alongside an acquaintance, Mohammed Avdol.

episodes.title: Who Will Be the Judge!?
episodes.summary: Jotaro heads to school and encounters a mysterious transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin.

episodes.title: Dio's Curse
episodes.summary: Jotaro is able to defeat Kakyoin. He takes the wounded Kakyoin back to his house, hoping to get some information about Dio.

episodes.title: Tower of Gray
episodes.summary: If they do not defeat Dio within 50 days, Holly could die - Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think Dio is hiding. While on the plane, they run into another one of Dio's assassins.

episodes.title: Silver Chariot
episodes.summary: Dio's next assassin, Polnareff attacks Jotaro and crew, Avdol faces him with his Magician's Red.

episodes.title: Dark Blue Moon
episodes.summary: With a new person in their party, they head to Singapore with the boat the Speedwagon Foundation provided them, during their journey Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.

episodes.title: Strength
episodes.summary: A giant ship shows itself . On board, they realize they can't seem to find a crew, but an orangutan.

episodes.title: Devil
episodes.summary: Arrived at Singapore, Jotaro's group stay at hotel individualy. A new Stand owner who is afraid as "Devo the Cursed" is awaited Polnareff in his room. Devo's Stand increases its power as its user's hatred toward opponent increases. Polnareff gets into desperate situation as he starts fighting front. Does Polnareff have a chance to win the battle from Devo who keeps attacking him with cruel and brutal way?

episodes.title: Yellow Temperance
episodes.summary: Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.

episodes.title: The Emperor and the Hanged Man, Part 1
episodes.summary: The group travels to India. In a restaurant Polnareff is attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.

episodes.title: The Emperor and the Hanged Man, Part 2
episodes.summary: In an effort to save Poinareff, Avdol is injured by the enemy. Then Centerfold's Stand, Hanged Man attacks.

episodes.title: The Empress
episodes.summary: The group heads toward Varanasi. On the way, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.

episodes.title: Wheel of Fortune
episodes.summary: Jotaro and the others head toward Pakistan in a car. Polnareff is driving the car on a very dangerous mountain road, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.

episodes.title: Justice, Part 1
episodes.summary: Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan. However, they decide to find an inn at a nearby village because of the dense fog they suddenly hit. The village they get to is rather quiet and all of the inhabitants seem rather odd.

episodes.title: Justice, Part 2
episodes.summary: Polnareff finally realizes that Enyaba is another assassin from DIO. He tries to warn the others, but Enyaba's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he is pursued. The whole village had already been under Enyaba's control.

episodes.title: The Lovers, Part 1
episodes.summary: After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel. Following DIO's orders, Dan of Steel ruthlessly kills Enyaba in front of them. Jotaro and the others can't help but feel conflicted about that happening, and end up in a battle with Dan of Steel.

episodes.title: The Lovers, Part 2
episodes.summary: Dan of Steel's Stand, The Lovers, has entered Joseph's brain. Dan puts himself at an advantage, with having Joseph's life on the line, and tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey. Meanwhile, Kakyoin and Polnareff also enter Joseph's brain with their Stands and find the Stand that is using brain cells as food.

episodes.title: The Sun
episodes.summary: Jotaro and the others continue their journey through the desert, trying to get to Cairo. They travel with camels and can't shake the feeling that someone is following them, but no one is in sight. Traveling in the killer heat, they realize that it's still bright out at 8pm and the sun is actually rising rather than setting.

episodes.title: Death 13, Part 1
episodes.summary: Kakyoin is dreaming and dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream, he witnesses Death cut down a dog. Kakyoin wakes up screaming, but can't remember what his bad dream was about.

episodes.title: Death 13, Part 2
episodes.summary: Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is suspicious, but that backfires, and his friends start to doubt his sanity. Kakyoin then tries to convince them that he's not crazy, and shows them his arm that has "Baby Stand" carved into it... but that just makes them believe he really is crazy. Kakyoin then tries to use his Stand to attack, but is knocked out by Polnareff. Eventually, Jotaro and the others wake up in the nightmare and the truth finally comes out.

episodes.title: Judgement, Part 1
episodes.summary: While on an island on the edge of the Red Sea where Mohammed Avdol's father is said to live, Polnareff uncovers a magic lamp and its genie Cameo offers him three wishes, although all is not as it seems.

episodes.title: Judgement, Part 2
episodes.summary: Polnareff must find out a way to escape the attacks of Cameo and his Stand Judgement who has apparently turned his sister Cherie and Avdol into zombies.

episodes.title: The High Priestess, Part 1
episodes.summary: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of travel. Through the Red Sea, they try to head toward Egypt where DIO awaits. Using the sonar to detect any threats on the outside, the submarine quietly dives in. They however realize that if they're attacked underwater, there is nowhere to escape, so they are on their guard. Finally, when they are about to surface, a coffee mug that was in the cabin transforms and cuts off Joseph's artificial hand.

episodes.title: The High Priestess, Part 2
episodes.summary: The group must find a way off of the submarine and away from the attacks of High Priestess.

episodes.title: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'Doul, Part 1
episodes.summary: Jotaro's group encounters N'Doul's Stand "Geb", and Iggy's "The Fool".

episodes.title: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'Doul, Part 2
episodes.summary: The group's battle with the water stand continues.

episodes.title: Khnum's Oingo and Tohth's Boingo
episodes.summary: Two brothers - Oingo, who can disguise himself, and Boingo, who can predict the future - set traps for Jotaro's group. But they end up as epic failures.

episodes.title: Anubis, Part 1
episodes.summary: A young man named Chaka finds a mysterious sword on the beach. Though other men try, Chaka is the only one who can draw it. The sword claims Chaka as its master and sends the youth in pursuit of Jotaro and his friends with deadly intent.

episodes.title: Anubis, Part 2
episodes.summary: Having defeated the "Anubis" Stand user Chaka, Polnareff pays a visit to a barber. But when the barber starts attacking him with Chaka's sword, the Frenchman realizes the sword itself is the Stand user.

episodes.title: Bastet's Mariah, Part 1
episodes.summary: On the way to Luxor, Joseph notices an electrical outlet set in a rock. Fascinated by the rare sight, Joseph goes in for a closer look and gets shocked. Though he seems fine afterwards, soon all manner of small accidents begin to occur around him.

episodes.title: Bastet's Mariah, Part 2
episodes.summary: Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized. While chasing after the woman he suspects is the Stand user, Joseph learns that Avdol has also become magnetized from touching a different electrical outlet.

episodes.title: Set's Alessi, Part 1
episodes.summary: While Joseph and Avdol are fighting with Mariah, Jotaro gets concerned that they haven't shown up yet, and goes to look for them around Luxor. Then, Polnareff senses someone following them and confronts the man.

episodes.title: Set's Alessi, Part 2
episodes.summary: Because of the power of Alessi's Stand, Set, Polnareff is turned back into a child. The one who came to his aid amidst his confusion was a woman named Marena. However, Alessi's evil hands followed Polnareff into her house.

episodes.title: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 1
episodes.summary: Arriving in Cairo, the Stardust Crusaders try to discover where Dio is, only to encounter D'Arby the Gambler. He is willing to give them the information they want, but only if they bet their souls against him in a game.

episodes.title: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 2
episodes.summary: With Joseph and Polnareff taken, Jotaro stands up to play D'Arby in a game of poker. With Osiris ready to steal Jotaro's soul, D'Arby is confident until he notices Jotaro's icy calm.

episodes.title: Hol Horse and Boingo, Part 1
episodes.summary: Hol Horse tries to take out Jotaro's group again, and enlists the future-telling Boingo to aid him.

episodes.title: Hol Horse and Boingo, Part 2
episodes.summary: Every time Boingo makes a prediction and Hol Horse tries to follow it, it goes wrong.

episodes.title: The Guardian of Hell: Pet Shop, Part 1
episodes.summary: Iggy separates from the group and has a bizarre adventure of his own.

episodes.title: The Guardian of Hell: Pet Shop, Part 2
episodes.summary: Under attack by Pet Shop and his Horus, Iggy has no choice but to flee into the sewers. Iggy can only hide using The Fool as the fearsome Pet Shop continues his barrage of ice attacks.

episodes.title: D'Arby the Player, Part 1
episodes.summary: Inside Dio's mansion, Terence T. D'Arby uses his Atum to drag the group into an illusion. With their souls on the line, the gang meet his challenge in a series of video games.

episodes.title: D'Arby the Player, Part 2
episodes.summary: Kakyoin is defeated by D'Arby and has his soul sealed inside of a puppet. Despite having no knowledge of games, Jotaro faces D'Arby next in a baseball game.

episodes.title: The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice, Part 1
episodes.summary: As Jotaro and Joseph continue to face off against D'Arby, Avdol and the others continue to explore the mansion. Little do they know that Dio's servant is watching them and unleashes his terrifying power.

episodes.title: The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice, Part 2
episodes.summary: Vanilla Ice, now powered up by Dio, uses his Cream to disintegrate Avdol. Iggy and Polnareff desperately try to fight back, but he remains too powerful for the duo to take down.

episodes.title: The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice, Part 3
episodes.summary: Polnareff is ready to accept his defeat, only to be rescued by the dying Iggy and harden's his resolve. Suzi comforts her daughter as Jotaro and Joseph get closer to where Dio lies in wait.

episodes.title: Dio's World, Part 1
episodes.summary: The Joestar group begin the fight against Dio, as Kakyoin learns the full extent of Dio's true power.

episodes.title: Dio's World, Part 2
episodes.summary: Kakyoin discovers The World's true power. The fight between Jotaro and Dio begins.

episodes.title: Dio's World, Part 3
episodes.summary: The fight between Jotaro and Dio continues.

episodes.title: Long Travels, Goodbye My Friend
episodes.summary: The final battle between Jotaro and Dio comes to a climactic end.

episodes.title: Jotaro Kujo! Meets Josuke Higashikata
episodes.summary: Ten years after battle in Egypt, Jotaro Kujo arrives to Morioh in Japan looking for Josuke Higashikata. He need to talk to Josuke about Joestar's heritage and tells him about dangerous Stand User who's hiding in town.

episodes.title: Josuke Higashikata! Meets Angelo
episodes.summary: Angelo uses his Aqua Necklace to attack Josuke's family and succeeds in killing his grandfather. Hungry for revenge, Jotaro and Josuke prepare to fight Angelo once more.

episodes.title: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 1
episodes.summary: Angelo reveals that he was given his Stand by a man in a school uniform using an arrow. Josuke and Koichi pass by a wrecked house where they discover the brothers Okuyasu and Keicho.

episodes.title: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 2
episodes.summary: After defeating Okuyasu and The Hand, Josuke enters the house to save Koichi. However, he soons find himself under attack by Keicho and his army Stand, Bad Company.

episodes.title: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 3
episodes.summary: Josuke and Koichi learn that the Nijimura brothers were giving people Stands to try and create one that could save their father. But just as a ceasefire begins, another enemy Stand appears before them.

episodes.title: Koichi Hirose (Reverb)
episodes.summary: Koichi finds himself stalked by Tamami Kobayashi, who tries to scam him using The Lock. But when his family is in Tamami's crosshairs, Koichi finally awakens the power of his Stand, Echoes.

episodes.title: Toshikazu Hazamada (Show Off)
episodes.summary: Josuke and Koichi get info that a student at their school, Toshikazu Hazamada may be a Stand user and decide to look into the case. Their suspicions are quickly confirmed after Hazamada's wooden doll morphs into an exact copy of Josuke, and attacks them.

episodes.title: Yukako Yamagishi Falls In Love, Part 1
episodes.summary: Koichi finds that he has captured the attention of Yukako Yamagishi, who claims to be in love with him. Things seem fine, until Yukako reveals that her feelings for Koichi go far beyond a simple crush.

episodes.title: Yukako Yamagishi Falls In Love, Part 2
episodes.summary: Now Yukako's prisoner, Koichi tries to escape the deranged woman using Echoes. But when he is pushed into a corner by Love Deluxe, a new power awakens within Echoes.

episodes.title: Let's Go Eat Some Italian Food
episodes.summary: Josuke and Okuyasu decide to eat some Italian at a new restaurant run by Tonio Trussardi. However, the food starts affecting Okuyasu and Josuke in strange ways, as Tonio appears to have a Stand.

episodes.title: Red Hot Chili Pepper, Part 1
episodes.summary: The electric Stand Red Hot Chili Pepper appears to taunt Josuke before vanishing. The gang learn that its user is targeting Joseph Joestar, and attempt to stop Chili Pepper from killing him.

episodes.title: Red Hot Chili Pepper, Part 2
episodes.summary: Josuke and the gang continue to fight Red Hot Chili Pepper and its user, Akira Otoishi. Powered up by electricity, Red Hot Chili Pepper proves to be a powerful for as Joseph's boat gets closer to Morioh.

episodes.title: We Picked Up Something Crazy!
episodes.summary: Josuke and Joseph find an invisible baby and adopt it.

episodes.title: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
episodes.summary: Hazamada and Koichi learn that one of their favorite mangaka, Rohan Kishibe, learns in Morioh. But when they go to visit him, the eccentric Rohan greets them with his Stand, Heaven's Door.

episodes.title: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
episodes.summary: Rohan uses Heaven's Door to read the secrets of Josuke's friends and puts them under special locks so that they can't stop him. Angered at seeing his friends hurt, Josuke approaches Rohan.

episodes.title: Let's Go Hunting!
episodes.summary: Josuke and Jotaro go hunting for a rat that has been given Stand abilities. While searching for their target, they find living things melted into flesh cubes and soon learn it isn't as simple as a mere rat.

episodes.title: Rohan Kishibe's Adventure
episodes.summary: Rohan and Koichi investigate a strange alley in Morioh that does not appear on any map. They get more than they bargained for when they meet the ghosts of Reimi and Arnold, who warn them of a dangerous presence in Morioh.

episodes.title: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 1
episodes.summary: Josuke and Okuyasu see strange hornet Stands, belonging to Shigechi, stealing money from all around Morioh. The three work together in a get rich quick scheme that soon goes awry.

episodes.title: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 2
episodes.summary: Shigechi, Okuyasu, and Josuke find themselves blinded by greed as they fight over a lottery ticket. When Stands get involved, it turns into a mad brawl over who will get the money.

episodes.title: Yukaku Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella
episodes.summary: Yukako is feeling down about her looks when she meets Aya Tsuji and Cinderella. She offers to give Yukako a makeover, but little does she know that such beauty comes with a price.

episodes.title: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
episodes.summary: Yoshikage Kira is a simple businessman who just wants to enjoy his sandwich for lunch. But a minor scuffle with Shigechi escalates when a horrific secret is revealed.

episodes.title: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
episodes.summary: Shigechi desperately tries to flee from Yoshikage Kira and Killer Queen, which can turn anything into a bomb. As he perishes, Shigechi gets a clue to Josuke and the others that sets them on a new path.

episodes.title: Sheer Heart Attack, Part 1
episodes.summary: Kira uses Sheer Heart Attack to kill his tailor and fight Josuke to prevent anyone from learning his secret. The indestructible tank proves to be tough, until Echoes manages to evolve yet again into Act 3.

episodes.title: Sheer Heart Attack, Part 2
episodes.summary: With Sheer Heart Attack beaten, Jotaro and Koichi finally encounter Kira himself. It seems like the final battle is underway as Stands clash, but then...

episodes.title: Atom Heart Father
episodes.summary: Searching for more clues about Kira, Josuke and the others investigate his old house. But Kira's father, still alive as a ghost, is determined to protect his son and unleashes Atom Heart Father on them.

episodes.title: Janken Boy Is Coming!
episodes.summary: Rohan encounters a boy named Ken, who is obsessed with janken. He accepts the boys challenge, only to end up playing a dangerous game with his Stand, Boy II Man.

episodes.title: I'm an Alien
episodes.summary: Josuke and Okuyasu encounter a weird boy named Mikitaka, who claims to be an alien. Possessing weird powers but no Stand, Mikitaka appears to be telling the truth as Josuke gets an idea.

episodes.title: Highway Go Go, Part 1
episodes.summary: Rohan and Josuke's game ends without Mikitala being discovered. As Rohan discovers something odd while on the train, a boy named Hayato suspects that his dad is acting strange.

episodes.title: Highway Go Go, Part 2
episodes.summary: Rohan has his energy drained by a nefarious Stand in Futatsumori Tunnel. Josuke flees the pursuing Highway Star on a motorcycle to try and track down its user at the hospital in town.

episodes.title: Cats Love Yoshikage Kira
episodes.summary: Kira has stolen the identity of another man to live in his house. He discovers a dead cat and buries it, only for the cat to resurrect as a Stand that still has a desire for revenge.

episodes.title: July 15th (Thurs), Part 1
episodes.summary: On July 15th, Josuke and the others discover a man living in an electric pylon and fall under the spell of Super Fly. Even stranger things then start happening over Morioh.

episodes.title: July 15th (Thurs), Part 2
episodes.summary: While Rohan deals with an odd architect who is terrified of his own back, Josuke defeats Super Fly only to encounter Terunosuke and his paper controlling Enigma.

episodes.title: July 15th (Thurs), Part 3
episodes.summary: Josuke succumbs to fear and is turned into paper , leading Yuya and Highway Star to save him. Rohan looks at the architect's back and becomes cursed by the Stand Cheap Trick.

episodes.title: July 15th (Thurs), Part 4
episodes.summary: Rohan tries to prevent anyway from seeing his back to avoid Cheap Trick's curse. Hayato sees Kira in action and confronts the imposter posing as his dad with hard evidence.

episodes.title: Bites the Dust, Part 1
episodes.summary: Kira gets a new power and tests it out on Hayato.

episodes.title: Bites the Dust, Part 2
episodes.summary: Hayato has gone back in time and attempts to warn everyone about Kira, but will he able to stop history from repeating?

episodes.title: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 1
episodes.summary: Having inadvertently revealed his true identity to Josuke, Yoshikage Kira is forced to fight him alongside Okuyasu, but does he have a trick up his sleeve?

episodes.title: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 2
episodes.summary: The battle between Josuke and Kira continues

episodes.title: Goodbye, Morioh - The Heart of Gold
episodes.summary: The final battle between Kira and the Morioh Warriors comes to a climactic end.

episodes.title: Golden Experience
episodes.summary: Giorno Giovanna has a dream, to become a Gang-Star! Inspired by a man he saved as a child, he sets out to join the shady organisation, Passione. Accompanied by his fellow gang members, Bruno, Mista, Narancia and Fugo, he unearths a terrifying secret about the boss of Passione. With the power of Gold Experience and the help of his friends, Giorno strides forth to achieve his dream.

episodes.title: Buccellati Is Coming
episodes.summary: Giorno is attacked by the mysterious Bruno Bucciarati. Using his Stand, Sticky Fingers, he relentlessly pursues Giorno. As he continues his fight with Bruno, Giorno reflects on his past and his decision to become a Gang-Star.

episodes.title: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
episodes.summary: In order to join the Passione organization, Giorno meets with Polpo, one of the capos in the gang who is currently in prison. He gives Giorno a test to prove his worth: keep a lighter burner for 24 hours without going out.

episodes.title: Joining the Gang
episodes.summary: Polpo's Stand, Black Sabbath, begins a relentless attack against Giorno from the shadows. As night begins to fall, Giorno is desperate to defeat his powerful foe. Will he be able to prove his worth and join the gang?

episodes.title: Find Polpo's Fortune!
episodes.summary: Bruno introduces Giorno to the other members of his team, who do not take kindly to the newcomer. In order to rise through the ranks, Bruno decides to track down Polpo's hidden fortune. The team heads to Capri to find the lost treasure.

episodes.title: Moody Blues' Counterattack
episodes.summary: As the team is attacked by an unseen enemy, Abbacchio uses the power of his Stand, Moody Blues, to replay the past and understand the nature of their opponent.

episodes.title: Six Bullets Appears, Part 1
episodes.summary: Torturing their enemy for information, the team learns that another Stand user is aiming to ambush them on Capri. Mista and Giorno go alone to the island to catch the enemy off guard.

episodes.title: Six Bullets Appears, Part 2
episodes.summary: Mista's Stand, Six Bullets, fights against Sale and his stand, Arts and Crafts.

episodes.title: The First Mission From the Boss
episodes.summary: Having found Polpo's treasure, Bruno is promoted to the role of capo. The mysterious boss of the organization gives them a mission: protect his daughter Trish and bring him to her safely. However, from the shadows an enemy watches.

episodes.title: Hitman Team
episodes.summary: A hit-man team, that seeks to overthrow the boss of the organization, begins to search for Trish. One of its members, Formaggio, attacks Narancia. Narancia fights back with his Aerosmith but Formaggio manages to hide from his attacks.

episodes.title: Narancia's Aerosmith
episodes.summary: Narancia continues to shrink due to the power of Formaggio's Little Feet. His Stand shrinks as well and his attacks barely affect the relentless Formaggio. Narancia tries to think of a way out as Formaggio tortures him for Trish's location.

episodes.title: The Second Mission from the Boss
episodes.summary: Fugo, Abbachio, and Giorno head to Pompeii to retrieve a key for the boss. However, another member of the hit-man team, Illuso, attacks them with his Stand, Man in the Mirror.

episodes.title: Man in the Mirror and Purple Haze
episodes.summary: Fugo is still trapped in the mirror world due to Man in the Mirror, who continues its attack. Giorno and Abbachio try to think of a way to save their friend as Fugo's Purple Haze rampages in the real world.

episodes.title: Express Train to Florence
episodes.summary: Using the power of the key in conjunction with a turtle, the gang hides on a train bound for Venice. However, two members of the hit-man team board as well, with Prosciutto unleashing his Stand on the hapless passengers.

episodes.title: The Grateful Dead Part 1
episodes.summary: The Grateful Dead slowly begins to age everybody on the train. With his teammates affected, Mista goes alone to confront the enemy, only to encounter Pesci and his Beach Boy.

episodes.title: The Grateful Dead Part 2
episodes.summary: To protect his teammates, Bruno manages to knock Prosciutto off the train to negate the aging power of The Grateful Dead, However, Pesci's resolve is hardened seeing his brother fight and he continues to attack Bruno.

episodes.title: Baby Face
episodes.summary: The gang tries to steal a car to travel to Venice in secret. Another hit-man, Melone, uses his Baby Face to impregnate a woman and create a soldier that pursues Giorno and the others.

episodes.title: Head to Venice!
episodes.summary: With Baby Face defeated, the group continues driving to Venice. A chill is in the air however, as Ghiaccio and his cold manipulating White Album unleash a barrage of ice attacks on Giorno and Mista.

episodes.title: White Ice
episodes.summary: Giorno drives into the canals of Venice in the hope of shaking off Ghiaccio. However, his White Album only operates better in ice, especially when he unleashes the power of his Gently Weeps.

episodes.title: The Final Mission from the Boss
episodes.summary: The boss gives the gang one final mission: deliver Trish to the top of a bell tower. Bruno takes Trish to the tower, reflecting on his past arriving to this point, but that's when the boss reveals his horrific true nature.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Emperor Crimson
episodes.summary: Bruno continues his desperate struggle against the boss, but cannot comprehend the nature of his Stand, King Crimson. When the dust settles, a decision is made that will change the lives of the gang forever.

episodes.title: The "G" in Gozzo
episodes.summary: Stopping for lunch at a cafe, the gang tries to determine what to do now that they are enemies of the Passione organization. Members of the elite squad then attack, unleashing the power of their Stands: Clash and Talking Head.

episodes.title: Crush and Talking Mouth
episodes.summary: Squalo's Clash and Tiziano's Talking Head continue their combination attack to kill Giorno and finish off the gang. Forced to only tell lies, Narancia has to try to get his friends to go after the real enemy and save Giorno's life.

episodes.title: Notorious B.I.G
episodes.summary: The gang manage to acquire a plane and aim to fly to Sardinia, after dispatching an enemy. However, once they are in the air, they find themselves under attack by a powerful and terrifying foe.

episodes.title: Spice Girl
episodes.summary: On the verge of death, Trish discovers and unlocks a Stand power.

episodes.title: A Little Story From the Past ~My Name Is Doppio~
episodes.summary: On the island of Sardinia, a boy named Doppio is searching for Trish and the others on orders from Passione's boss. But Doppio has a dark secret, one that becomes apparent when he encounters Risotto of La Squadra.

episodes.title: King Crimson vs Metallica
episodes.summary: Doppio, the alter ego of Passione's boss, continues to fight against Risotto and his iron controlling Metallica. Doppio struggles against the powerful assassin, but is armed with King Crimson's Epitaph, which allows him to see the future.

episodes.title: Beneath a Sky on the Verge of Falling
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the battle between Risotto and Doppio, Abbacchio uses Moody Blues to try and uncover the boss's identity. But the boss is adamant about keeping his identity a secret and executes his next gambit against the group.

episodes.title: Get to the Roman Colosseum!
episodes.summary: Unsure of what to do next, the gang receive a strange message on their computer revealing the origins of the Stand arrow and the true name of Passione's boss. The gang aim to travel to Rome as two assassins wait in the shadows.

episodes.title: Green Day and Oasis, Part 1
episodes.summary: The gang are under attack by the last two members of the Elite Squad. Cioccolata uses his Green Day to spread a toxic mold over the island while Secco uses Oasis to swim through rock for stealth attacks, leaving the gang in a pinch.

episodes.title: Green Day and Oasis, Part 2
episodes.summary: While Bruno stays on the ground to fight against Secco's Oasis, Giorno and Mista head upwards towards Cioccolata to stop the power of his Green Day. But Cioccolata has another dangerous trick up his sleeve, pushing the two into a corner.

episodes.title: Green Day and Oasis, Part 3
episodes.summary: Bruno and Secco are both racing towards the man at the Colloseum whilst trying to kill each other.

episodes.title: His Name Is Diavolo
episodes.summary: Bruno unknowingly leads Doppio to the Colosseum while the rest of the gang is searching for their leader.

episodes.title: The Requiem Quietly Plays, Part 1
episodes.summary: Everyone wakes up from a deep sleep to discover their souls have been swapped.

episodes.title: The Requiem Quietly Plays, Part 2
episodes.summary: The gang desperately tries to reach the Stand arrow whilst looking for Diavolo.

episodes.title: Diavolo Surfaces
episodes.summary: Everyone continues to desperately chase after the Requiem in order to obtain the Stand arrow. Diavolo's soul is then forced to show itself, but he will not quit until he obtains the arrow for himself.

episodes.title: King Of Kings
episodes.summary: The Stand arrow's rightful owner is finally revealed.

episodes.title: Golden Experience Requiem
episodes.summary: Giorno achieves his dream and destiny of becoming a Gang-star.

episodes.title: The Sleeping Slave
episodes.summary: In the past, Bruno and his team investigated the mysterious death of a girl and how it ties into the power known as Rolling Stones. And in the present, the final fate of Giorno and the gang is revealed as Golden Wind comes to a close.

episodes.title: Stone Ocean
episodes.summary: Florida, 2011. Framed for a DUI and imprisoned, young Jolyne gains a mysterious new power after receiving a bizarre item from her estranged father.

episodes.title: Prisoner FE40536: Jolyne Cujoh
episodes.summary: Jolyne gets acquainted with Green Dolphin Street Prison and her two-faced cellmate, Gwess, who has obtained Jolyne's locket and a pint-sized new Stand.

episodes.title: The Visitor (1)
episodes.summary: Jolyne acclimates to prison, but a mysterious boy delivers an ominous message before Jolyne receives a visit from her father and an enemy Stand user.

episodes.title: The Visitor (2)
episodes.summary: DIO's follower Johngalli A. aims for revenge. The boy risks his safety to help Jotaro and Jolyne, but she refuses to leave the kid behind.

episodes.title: Prisoner of Love
episodes.summary: Father and daughter try to escape the visiting room's trap and the prison, but an enemy Stand extracts two discs from Jotaro. One holds Star Platinum.

episodes.title: Ermes's Stickers
episodes.summary: Jolyne returns to prison to retrieve Jotaro's discs. Ermes Costello discovers her new ability and a guard with discs in his head before she's attacked.

episodes.title: There's Six of Us!
episodes.summary: After people go missing from the prison's farm, Jolyne and Ermes volunteer to join the search party as a way to look for Pale Snake and the discs.

episodes.title: F.F.
episodes.summary: Jolyne and Ermes unravel the mystery of Stand F.F. and its user, who admits to helping Pale Snake in his efforts to steal their Stands.

episodes.title: Debt Collector Mary Lynn Manson
episodes.summary: Pale Snake's user, Father Pucchi, makes his entrance. A baseball game in the yard against Miraschon heats up when F.F. and Stone Ocean get involved.

episodes.title: Operation Savage Guardian (Head to the Courtyard!) (1)
episodes.summary: Assisted by Emporio and his friend Weather Forecast, Jolyne rushes to the courtyard to pass Jotaro's Stand Disc to the Speedwagon Foundation.

episodes.title: Operation Savage Guardian (Head to the Courtyard!) (2)
episodes.summary: Father Pucchi learns some damning information. Jolyne and Weather's bodies strain under Jumpin' Jack Spark's Stand ability as the fight continues.

episodes.title: Torrential Downpour Warning
episodes.summary: Jolyne reaches the courtyard. Pucchi recalls his talks with DIO and his reason for hunting Jotaro when Weather unleashes a squall of poison dart frogs.

episodes.title: Kiss of Love and Revenge (1)
episodes.summary: Jolyne and F.F. discover that Ermes got herself sent to prison to track down and kill a notorious gangster who murdered her older sister.

episodes.title: Kiss of Love and Revenge (2)
episodes.summary: Ermes, Jolyne and F.F. find out that Maxx has turned into an invisible zombie and escaped from the pipe. Maxx lures them into the prison's mausoleum and revives several dead prisoners.

episodes.title: Ultra Security House Unit
episodes.summary: F.F. and Emporio find out that forced Maxx was forced to bring one of DIO's bones back to life. Narciso Anasui agrees to help F.F. rescue Jolyne.

episodes.title: The Secret of Guard Westwood
episodes.summary: Jolyne faces off against Westwood. Westwood's Stand attracts small meteorites towards him that seriously wound his enemies.

episodes.title: Enter the Dragon's Dream
episodes.summary: Only two other inmates are left standing after the brawl in the Disciplinary Wing. F.F. arrives in time to fight one of them, an elderly former cult leader named Kenzou.

episodes.title: Enter the F.F.
episodes.summary: F.F. attempts to get water and heal themselves, only to trigger Kenzou's Stand again and become trapped in an active electric chair.

episodes.title: Birth of the "Green"
episodes.summary: Jolyne, F.F. and Anasui confront the prisoner who had DIO's bone and find that he and the rest of the inmates are turning into plants when exposed to sunlight.

episodes.title: F.F. – The Witness
episodes.summary: Jolyne, Anasui and Yo-Yo Ma steal a boat to approach the main prison. After Jolyne's tongue is suddenly dissolved by mosquitoes carrying Yo-Yo Ma's acidic spit, she attempts to warn Anasui of the Stand's power.

episodes.title: AWAKEN
episodes.summary: Jolyne and Anasui attempt to retrieve The Green Baby, but find themselves shrinking whenever they get close to it as a result of the infant's Stand.

episodes.title: Time for Heaven! New Moon! New Priest!
episodes.summary: F. F. and Weather meet up with Jolyne and Anasui and reveal that Pucci is Whitesnake's user. But the Weather with them is not who he seems to be...

episodes.title: Jail House Lock!
episodes.summary: Pucci leaves Green Dolphin Street Prison to enact the next part of the plan to attain heaven. After viewing her Jotaro's memory disc and discovering Pucci's plans, Jolyne decides to break out of prison and stop him.

episodes.title: Jailbreak...
episodes.summary: Emporio remembers that he wanted to print a picture of the guard's face. But Miu Miu appears and shoots both the boy and his computer.

episodes.title: Bohemian Ecstatic (1)
episodes.summary: Pucci tries to stay ahead of Jolyne, but is held hostage outside a hospital.

episodes.title: Bohemian Ecstatic (2)
episodes.summary: Anasui tries to recover his physical body after the enemy Stand Bohemian Ecstatic separates it from his soul.

episodes.title: Sky Guy
episodes.summary: Jolyne and her companions are attacked in Romeo's helicopter on the way to Cape Canaveral.

episodes.title: Heaven is at Hand: Three Days Until the New Moon
episodes.summary: Jolyne and Ermes enter the hospital and find a hole in the floor.

episodes.title: Netherworld
episodes.summary: Jolyne jumps out of the plane and launches an attack, but it doesn't affect Versus.

episodes.title: Heavy Forecast (1)
episodes.summary: Weather Forecast's powerful ability Heavy Forecast triggers automatically, turning everyone affected by it into snails.

episodes.title: Heavy Forecast (2)
episodes.summary: Pucci's and Weather Report's past is revealed.

episodes.title: Heavy Forecast (3)
episodes.summary: Jolyne and her comrades hurry to stop Weather Forecast's Stand. In the meantime, Weather Forecast decides to settle the score with Pucci.

episodes.title: Gravity of the New Moon
episodes.summary: Jolyne and her comrades head to Cape Canaveral in pursuit of Pucci, whose body begins to change.

episodes.title: See Moon (1)
episodes.summary: Jolyne struggles against Pucci's new Stand See Moon, which can invert anything it touches.

episodes.title: See Moon (2)
episodes.summary: Pucci senses that Jolyne is still alive and pursues her in hopes of ending the Joestar bloodline for good.

episodes.title: Maiden Heaven (1)
episodes.summary: Jolyne and her companions awake to find that Pucci is gone and gravity has returned to normal.

episodes.title: Maiden Heaven (2)
episodes.summary: Pucci's new Stand Maiden Heaven overwhelms Jolyne's group. Therefore, Anasui acts as bait while Jotaro prepares to attack.

episodes.title: It's a Wonderful World
episodes.summary: The unstoppable acceleration of time brings the universe full circle. Emporio awakes in Green Dolphin Street Prison and humanity enters a new world.
